derived_thresholds.estimator: min_improvement = round_up(primary_grid, max(placebo_max_abs_primary_difference, relative_floor * baseline_primary_level)); secondary_limit[m] = round_up(grid[m], placebo_max_abs_difference[m])

evidence_rules.date_evidence_unit: one trading day; resampling unit is a block of consecutive trading days inside one declared period and blocks never cross a period gap
evidence_rules.note: the sealed interval is one period; no further months are required because the interval is read exactly once

extends.relationship: same threshold_basis, same estimator, same secondary degradation lines, same resource budget; only the periods and the repeat condition change

index_guard.rule: if any indexed run already intersects the sealed interval the one-shot check is compromised and the extension is refused

instantiate_with: PYTHONPATH=src;. .venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/sealed_final_prereg.py --register --baseline <sealed baseline object> --candidate <sealed candidate object>

object_policy_template.threshold_rationale: Primary floor = max(largest |paired daily difference| among the six equal-quality 3-seed/blend pairs, 2% of the measured baseline level). The six pairs are the three 3-seed trunk ensembles and the nine-checkpoint blend that contains them, so the largest pair difference is an upper bound on how far a nominally equivalent alternative sits from the incumbent; requiring more than that difference is stricter than 2% of the baseline level. Every secondary limit is the same largest |difference| for that metric, so a candidate may not give back more than one measured spurious-difference scale on any secondary metric. Pair set, estimator and grids were declared in the measurement plan before any metric was computed.

periods.rule: the sealed interval is evaluated exactly once as one period; splitting it into segments, shortening it, or reopening it is a repeated peek and is refused

placeholders.baseline_object: sealed-window re-evaluation of the incumbent baseline; recorded by path at registration without reading its metrics
placeholders.candidate_object: the single frozen candidate; recorded by path at registration without reading its metrics
placeholders.registered_at: UTC timestamp written at instantiation; must be later than every candidate artifact start

prohibitions: no lowering min_improvement, any secondary limit, or the 5bp stress scenario after seeing the sealed result
no splitting the sealed interval into several periods and reporting the best one
no re-running the sealed evaluation with a different candidate or a tuned variant
no substituting research-window evidence for the sealed verdict
no reporting local 5bp net return as an official score
purpose: one-shot sealed final check of the frozen baseline and the single frozen candidate on [2024-10-08, 2025-01-01); land it with --register immediately before reading the sealed interval and never re-open that interval

conclusion_templates.accept: 封存终检通过：RankIC 配对日块增益 {improvement} >= 预登记门槛 {min_improvement}，95% 区间 [{low}, {high}] 不含零，资源与次要/5bp 门均通过。
conclusion_templates.inconclusive: 封存终检证据不足：{missing_evidence}。区间只读一次，不重复取样；若需更多证据只能另立方案并使用新的未用数据区。
conclusion_templates.reject: 封存终检未通过：{failed_gates}。门槛与情景未调整，维持冻结基线；不得据该结果调整后再次评估同一区间。

verdict.decision_authority: scripts/promotion_gate.py produces the verdict from this frozen registration; there is no manual override and no post-hoc edit
